answer: Each identity joins the graph by one attestation edge; edges fall into components. A component shares one marble: the payout its members draw and the liability they carry. If any address inside it is proven sybil, the marble cracks for all of them, so nectar banked by honest neighbours is forfeit too. A clone becomes a liability, not an asset: each fake needs its own component, and one stays separate only while no edge touches another. In an ocean of overlapping attestations, N isolated clusters cost N distinct sponsors and N chances to shatter someone else's marble.
